sources.title: GitHub - antirez/llama.cpp-deepseek-v4-flash: Experimental ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek v4 Flash experimental support This is a fork of llama.cpp that implements DSv4 support, with generated GGUF that aims to target MacBooks with just 128GB of RAM using 2bit quantization of routed experts. Disclaimer: This code was written with heavy help from GPT 5.5 and the official DeepSeek v4 Flash as reference.
